result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: one major image loading failure, one minor text truncation, and one minor partially visible UI element.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner overlaid on the image, indicating the image failed to load or is still loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images are preloaded or use a proper placeholder/skeleton screen instead of showing a spinner directly on the content area. Investigate network or CDN issues causing the image load failure.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is truncated mid-word, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card to be slightly wider, reduce font size, or use an ellipsis (...) at a word boundary rather than cutting off mid-word to improve readability.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (after 'Healthy') is partially cut off on the right edge of the screen, making it unclear what category it represents.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance (e.g., a fade/gradient on the right edge) to clearly indicate horizontal scrollability, and ensure the partial pill is not mistaken for a rendering error.
